rationale: The plan correctly keeps RSEM expected counts as counts (edgeR unrounded, DESeq2 rounded), never substitutes TPM/FPKM, uses TMM inside the model with filterByExpr, and states BH at 0.05 with a sensible keep-plus-sensitivity policy for the shallow sample. It does not request the genes.results files or name the lost effective-length offset as such (it frames the loss only as 'TPM cannot be recomputed'), the QC has library sizes but no PCA or sample-distance heatmap, the design formula and reference level are never written out, and no fold-change shrinkage (apeglm or edgeR predFC) is applied to the reported effects. Enrichment was not requested; the added ORA names a universe but no collection version or gene-set size window. The report omits package versions.
